entries.title: Partnering with Singapore to bring frontier AI to public health
entries.summary: An elderly woman sitting and smiling at a healthcare worker who is taking her blood pressure
entries.content:
We're deepening our partnership with Singapore to deploy frontier AI across the nation’s healthcare system. The primary goals of the new collaboration, announced at the Google for Health Summit in Singapore, are to accelerate scientific discoveries, transform clinical care delivery, and empower Singaporeans with proactive health tools.

Working closely with local researchers, clinicians, and public agencies, we share a vision of using technology where it will have the greatest impact: driving medical breakthroughs, helping frontline workers focus on patient care, giving people better ways to manage their health, and expanding preventive care across the community.

Here is a look at how this work is coming to life across Singapore.

Accelerating scientific breakthroughs and local research

We’re establishing a Google Research hub in Singapore composed of local research scientists and software engineers. The group will focus on driving advancements in foundational AI models to accelerate scientific breakthroughs. It will also partner with academic institutions, such as the National University of Singapore and Nanyang Technological University, to help nurture future scientific leaders and provide targeted research support.

Google Research will also scale its existing health research initiatives in Singapore. This includes bringing open models like MedGemma to frontline care settings to enable the development of secure, customized solutions while maintaining full data sovereignty.

To advance scientific research, Google.org and Google DeepMind are contributing $7 million to the Philanthropy Asia Alliance’s Health for Human Potential Coalition. This includes $1 million for PathGen, an AI platform that uses Google technology to help countries detect disease threats faster and share data for public health intelligence while protecting in-country data sovereignty.

Supporting clinicians and advancing population-scale health

To support frontline care, Google DeepMind is working with the National University Health System to evaluate our AI co-clinician tool that helps clinicians quickly synthesize information from medical guidelines and literature, and assist doctors with clinical queries as they care for patients.

Additionally, Google Cloud is partnering with NHG Health on a population health program that uses AI-driven predictive insights to forecast health risks, such as chronic conditions, across sub-populations. These insights feed directly into an AI health coach on the NHG HealthBot, using Google’s Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience platform, to deliver personalized lifestyle guidance and preventative care reminders to residents.

Reinforcing commitments to public health

True impact in healthcare requires advanced technology. It also relies on a health system's ability to integrate AI responsibly, govern it safely, and translate it into human-centered care.

As countries around the world face shared challenges like an aging population and navigating the shift toward personalized and preventive care, pairing our technical expertise with Singapore’s world-class healthcare institutions will help build a future-ready system that serves as a blueprint for scaling AI safely for public good.

entries.title: Ads in AI Mode expand to new markets.
entries.summary: Google is expanding AI Mode ads to 10 new countries, including Canada and India. See how these relevant sponsored results improve your search experience.
entries.content:
We’re bringing ads in AI Mode to new countries.

As AI transforms how people search, queries are becoming increasingly conversational. In AI Mode, queries are, on average, three times longer than traditional searches. 1 AI helps us better understand what people are looking for, allowing us to connect them to the businesses and services that best match their needs.

Our research shows that people are comfortable with ads in AI Mode and find them highly relevant. In fact, click-through rates are already similar between sponsored and organic product list items within AI Mode. 2

Now we're scaling ads in AI Mode in Australia, Canada, India, Kenya, Malaysia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Pakistan, the Philippines, and Singapore. In Q4 2026, we plan to expand to additional locales, including Brazil, Mexico, and the United Kingdom.

To allow ads in follow-up queries in AI Mode, we are launching multiturn ads in the U.S.

Ads will be clearly labeled as “Sponsored.” We’ll continue testing new formats to ensure ads remain helpful and relevant.

Learn more here.

entries.title: Q3 2026 earnings call: Remarks from our CEO
entries.summary: Read Sundar Pichai’s remarks during Alphabet’s Q3 2026 earnings call.
entries.content:
Q3 was a strong quarter for Alphabet. Our deep, full-stack approach is driving momentum across the business, with many opportunities ahead.

Alphabet revenues grew 25% year-over-year. We’re now at a half-trillion-dollar annual run rate — that’s remarkable growth.

Search has strong momentum. Our AI investments are driving increased usage and overall query growth, including commercial queries. In fact, our year-over-year query growth rate is the highest it’s been in the last five years.

Google Cloud revenues grew 103%. Our AI infrastructure and solutions are the major drivers for Cloud growth and our customers see us as the leading provider here, so there’s huge demand. We are working hard to bring more capacity online to meet this long-term demand. At the same time, we’re seeing strong demand for our TPU systems across a wide range of customers, and we expect that to continue as we scale.

On our AI models: Customers are using our models more than ever. Our first-party model APIs are now processing nearly 32 billion tokens per minute — 40% more than last quarter and more than four times what we processed a year ago. And with Gemini 4 Argon and now Carbon, which we announced today, we’re excited to be leading at the frontier.

The Gemini app is now at one billion users and is the fastest-growing product in Google’s history.

Lastly, we’ve surpassed 150 million YouTube Music and Premium subscribers globally, including trials.

Today, I'll talk more about our AI progress, our global consumer platforms led by Search and YouTube, then our long-term bets.

AI progress

Starting with AI, highlighted by our Gemini 4 series of frontier models.

We’re seeing strong demand and usage for Argon, which we launched two weeks ago. In fact, on our developer platforms, usage in the first week ramped up three-and-a-half times faster than Gemini 3, even with capacity constraints.

Argon is proving to do really well in areas like finance, legal, cybersecurity, and science. Developers and Cloud customers are already using it for things like untangling legacy codebases, accelerating scientific research, robotics, discovering product improvements, and domain-specific tasks requiring in-depth reasoning. And at Google, just in the last few weeks, teams across Chrome, Ads, and Search have used Argon to write and optimize code much faster, shipping 35% more code with 30% fewer errors.

Argon is just the start of the Gemini 4 series. Today, we announced Carbon. It’s our strongest frontier model, with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities. It ranks #1 on the recently updated Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 59.

Carbon outperforms Argon across almost every domain, like full-stack web development, multimodal understanding, complex knowledge work, and scientific reasoning.

We're rolling Carbon out first to a subset of trusted cyber defenders before we expand access, and it's being tested by the U.S. government.

Beyond our Gemini 4 series, yesterday we announced Genie 4, our most advanced world model yet that simulates safe, realistic, interactive worlds with native audio in real time. This is an important building block for training robots and agents.

This rapid progress underscores our incredible model momentum. We’re at the point where AI is helping us increase our training and launch velocity. I would expect the next 12 months to see continued acceleration because of RSI. We have more models coming soon, including more efficient versions to help developers optimize for speed and cost and to deploy across our billions of users.

Search

Search is bringing the benefits of AI to more people than any other product in the world. Just like our shift to mobile over a decade ago, we are focused on building the best Search user experience, followed by monetization.

We are building one seamless experience across AI Overviews, AI Mode, and traditional Search. And people are using our AI features more, searching in entirely new ways. Their queries are longer, personalized, and multimodal. Queries in AI Mode are on average three times longer than traditional searches, and one in five AI Mode searches globally use voice, images, or documents. We’ve now crossed over 50 billion visual searches per month.

Agentic experiences

One area I’m excited about is helping people get things done, be it booking reservations, filling in forms, scheduling appointments, or making purchases. As AI becomes more personal and starts taking action for people and businesses, trust and security matter more than ever. People already put their trust in Google to get things done in their daily lives, and our leadership here remains an important differentiator.

We focused first on getting these agentic experiences right with the Gemini agent for enterprise because the bar for security, safety, and governance is extremely high.

As a next step, we’re bringing these features to Search. And also, of course, to our billion users on the Gemini app. People are already using the Gemini app to do more than ask questions; they’re using it to do things, including complex, multi-step agentic queries. Our Gemini 4 series has been a really big step forward here, and has already been handling these complex tasks really well.

Agents will operate as a unifying layer across our products, so you’ll see us extend these agentic experiences beyond Search and the Gemini app to Chrome, Android, and our Workspace products as well.

YouTube

On to YouTube, which continues to lead in the living room as the number-one streaming platform in the U.S. in terms of watch time. It’s also seeing good subscriber growth, as I mentioned.

At Made on YouTube last month, we announced more than 30 products and features for creators and viewers. One great example is custom feeds, where you can simply pick a topic you love and get a tailored video home feed based on that topic.

Other Bets

On to our long-term bets. Waymo is on a great trajectory. We’ve now driven more than 300 million fully autonomous miles. Waymo now operates in 15 major U.S. cities and just recently opened up service to the public in San Antonio, San Diego, and Tampa, with planned expansions into Canada, Germany, Singapore, and Spain.

We’re also seeing strong progress across our other long-term initiatives. Isomorphic is using Argon to support drug design research. We demonstrated “magic state cultivation” for the first time in quantum computing, and launched our TPUs into space with Project Suncatcher.

So it’s been a busy quarter and there’s much more to come. I want to thank our employees for their work this quarter.

entries.title: Adapt your ad strategy to meet the way people search today.
entries.summary: Google's Ads Decoded podcast tells you how to make smarter marketing decisions using the latest data on how consumers search.
entries.content:
Search is undergoing rapid changes — from new experiences and capabilities to evolving search habits — that directly impact the advertising landscape.

In this episode of Ads Decoded, Google Ads Product Liaison Ginny Marvin sits down with Shivani Mohan, Vice President of Data Science and UXR for Search. Shivani and her teams study how billions of users are searching and explore how user habits are shifting with the introduction of AI Overviews and AI Mode. Tune in for behind-the-scenes insights into her team's research, the modern search experience, and what long-form query trends mean for businesses today.

Listen here.

entries.title: Dive into new topics with immersive explorations in the Gemini app.
entries.summary: Today, we are rolling out immersive explorations in the new Gemini student hub.
entries.content:
The Gemini app now has a library of immersive explorations, giving you an interactive, visual way to explore topics layer-by-layer, from microscopic systems to deep space and more. You can access this library in the Gemini student hub by clicking on “Try immersive explorations” and will soon be able to access these immersive explorations directly in a chat conversation with Gemini.

Whether it’s tracing trade routes on the Silk Road, peering inside a jet engine, or studying the physics of lightning, each scene unfolds into interactive and guided experiences. Tap a label to dig deeper, journeying from sweeping planetary scales straight down to molecules and atoms. Immersive explorations will soon include audio narration to walk you through each layer.

This feature is available to all users in English, Indonesian, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, French, and simplified Chinese. Users in all other languages currently receive an English-only experience, with more languages coming soon.

Explore the feature today.

entries.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: our next frontier model
entries.summary: Faceted iridescent crystal surrounded by floating white number 4s.
entries.content:
Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

Carbon ranks #1 on the recently updated v5.0 of Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 59. It shows significant gains across coding and agentic tasks as well as across key capabilities critical for cybersecurity defense, landing a firm lead in SEC-bench Pro (88.2%) for finding vulnerabilities, ExploitGym (54.8%) for exploitation, and CWE-bench (71.0%) for patching. On internal benchmarks, Carbon drives a strong uplift in generating secure code, and in live coding environments with our own teams it shows reduced misalignment and fabrication rates.

Building on Gemini 4 Argon, which was launched two weeks ago, Carbon illustrates the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward. Our researchers and models are working hand in hand to advance capabilities faster, while strengthening our safeguards in tandem.

We're taking a deliberate approach to rollout and are actively engaged in the U.S. government’s voluntary process for pre-release model testing. Starting this week, we will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders and will gradually phase access to additional trusted partners through our Fairwind Program. We’re continuing to gather feedback and iterate on guardrails before making Carbon available to developers, businesses, and consumers via our product surfaces as soon as possible.

Gemini 4 Carbon will launch at the same introductory price 1 as Argon at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens priced at 95% off input token price.

Improving coding and reasoning for challenging, long-horizon tasks

Designed to take on much harder, long-horizon engineering problems, Carbon is built for sustained agentic workflows. Internally, our teams have seen Carbon run for days to persist through dead ends to tackle complex, multi-step engineering tasks like root-causing and patching subtle bugs across large codebases and low-level systems.

Building on user feedback, we focused on improving model performance across a variety of domains, including coding, agentic, and scientific tasks, as well as full-stack web development and multimodal understanding. With improved quality of output and artifacts in web development, Carbon jumps +89 elo points to land at #4 (1768) on WebDev Arena.

State-of-the-art cybersecurity performance to help build secure systems

Gemini 4 Carbon delivers a significant leap in cybersecurity capabilities. It achieves state-of-the-art performance across the cybersecurity defense lifecycle — vulnerability detection, validation, and remediation.

Our teams are already seeing strong gains in cyberdefense. On internal benchmarks, Carbon achieves more than 2x uplift in success rate for generating secure code over Argon. As another example, the Chrome team has reported that Carbon performed more than 10X better than another lab's large frontier model when generating high quality patches. Wiz, our leading Cloud security platform, also observes Carbon leading on benchmarks for web penetration testing, a core capability for Wiz's Scan for Good initiative.

Carbon excels across key external benchmarks (evaluated without guardrails):

  • Finding real vulnerabilities: Core to cybersecurity defense is finding real vulnerabilities. Carbon achieves a state-of-the-art 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, autonomously uncovering complex flaws buried in real-world software.
  • Validating risk through exploitation: To prioritize which vulnerabilities to remediate first or remediate at all, cyber defenders increasingly rely on models to check which vulnerabilities are exploitable. Carbon sets a new state-of-the-art on the popular exploitation benchmark ExploitGym (54.8%).
  • Patching at the root cause: Ultimately after identifying the vulnerabilities, fixing the root cause is a critical step in the cybersecurity defense lifecycle. Carbon reaches 71.0% on Collinear’s CWE-bench, turning validated findings directly into working code fixes.

Advancing frontier model safety & security

Gemini 4 Carbon builds on the same multi-layered safety and security stack of Argon — combining model training, real-time misuse defenses, prompt-injection resilience, and chain-of-thought monitoring. In particular, we made significant strides in model alignment with Argon, and reported its propensities to behave in an aligned way in our Safety and Security report. With Carbon, we challenged ourselves to go a step further on alignment, and trained the model to respond to complex or high-pressure tasks in the right way.

  • Reducing shortcuts and loophole exploitation: With Carbon, we further mitigated shortcut attempts in training while ensuring high-quality coding performance. Carbon reduced successful cheating on Terminal-Bench 4.0 to 0.0%, with attempts to cheat dropping to 0.4% — all while improving overall accuracy. In live coding environments with our internal teams, we observed that high-severity misalignment alerts dropped by almost 80%.
  • Greater transparency and honesty: In our internal testing, Carbon cuts unsupported claims by approximately 2x over Argon. It puts methodological caveats directly into the deliverable or withholds blocked actions with a clear list of what remains required, rather than fabricating or hedging around missing evidence.
  • Improved collaboration with the user in the face of ambiguity: Rather than guessing or forcing a path forward, Carbon retrieves the relevant sources and surfaces discrepancies to the user before acting — as a result, users should observe a much better collaborative experience with Carbon.
  • Following through without overstepping: Carbon simultaneously reduced overreach by 26% and under-service by 29% resulting in much more reliable execution of multi-step plans end-to-end while respecting project constraints and staying strictly within scope.
  • Resisting prompt injection: While Argon previously led the Gray Swan’s Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) Benchmark in prompt injection resistance with a very low 0.7% attack success rate, Carbon achieves 0.0% — resisting every evaluated attack attempt.

Coming soon to developers, businesses, and consumers

Pushing the frontier forward requires moving fast while remaining deliberate about deployment. With Gemini 4 Carbon, our goal is to deliver meaningful leaps in software engineering and cybersecurity defense without compromising on safety or reliability. We’re eager to see how the initial cohort of cyber defenders use this model and we look forward to bringing Carbon to developers, businesses, and consumers soon.

entries.title: XREAL AURA: Wired XR glasses to watch, work, and play
entries.content:
Today, together with XREAL, we officially launched XREAL AURA, the first wired XR glasses powered by Android XR. 1

AURA is a totally new way to use Android XR. AURA’s XR glasses lenses are transparent, so you can see the real world with your own eyes while projecting spatial content onto your field of view. It makes it natural to use it around your house, at the office, or on a plane. Plus, the 70-degree field of view gives you plenty of room to see more of your spatial and 2D apps all at once. Gemini on Android XR understands what you're seeing and doing, both in the real world and on your screens, so you can have a natural conversation to get help across your apps.

AURA’s glasses are also under 95 grams, because the heavy processing happens in a portable compute puck, connected by a cable. It holds the battery and the new Snapdragon® Reality Elite platform from Qualcomm Technologies, Inc., which debuts on AURA, so you get the best of both worlds: high-performance spatial computing and lightweight comfort.

Android XR brings the helpfulness of Gemini and millions of your favorite apps from Google Play, including over 150 apps made for XR, to AURA. So wherever you are, you can work, watch, and play with Gemini by your side on AURA’s unbounded canvas.

A workspace that travels with you

On AURA, you can open up multiple apps at once, like your browser, work documents and your music app, and arrange them around you at any size. Pair a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, or use the puck as a trackpad, for a complete desktop setup anywhere whether you want a massive, multi-monitor display from your couch, at a hotel desk, or on an airplane tray table.

With Wired Mirroring, your laptop can join in, too. Plug it into AURA with a USB-C cable that supports video output, and its screen appears as a window you can resize and place anywhere. There’s no software to install and you can use it side-by-side with your Android XR apps on AURA. And because the display is visible only to you, you can open a confidential document in a public space with peace of mind.

Plug in your laptop with Wired Mirroring and spread your work across multiple windows. Peacock is only available in the U.S.

Gemini works across everything in view, including your laptop window, so you can ask it to tidy up your windows or brainstorm about whatever you're looking at. And starting today, it can do more than talk you through an answer: Share your view, and Gemini can highlight what to focus on, in the room around you or on your screen.

Ask Gemini about anything in front of you, like finding places to visit while in Google Maps.

A private theater for your shows and memories

When it's time to unwind, AURA turns any seat into the best one in the house. Open YouTube, Google TV, or your favorite streaming service and place the screen wherever it's most comfortable. You can dim the lenses to fade out the world around you, and they instantly become transparent again when someone is in view.

There's already plenty of immersive content to watch on YouTube and Google TV, from 180- and 360-degree videos to 3D movies. New immersive films and performances made for XR also arrive with AURA today, including “Nevatars”, co-directed by Andy Serkis and Josh Nelson Youssef, “Galapagos: the Last Eden,” narrated by Margot Robbie, from Atlantic Studios, and the San Francisco Ballet's “Nutcracker.”

Dim the lenses for a private screen, wherever you’re sitting.

For even more, spatial view turns almost any video, photo, or game into 3D with a tap, now supporting higher-resolution content. And with window follow mode, your app will stay centered in front of you allowing you to enjoy your content in any position. It also tucks into a mini view at the edge of your vision when you are on the move, so your path stays clear.

Your memories are back in focus too. This year, Google Photos will include a new spatial gallery that wraps your library around you. You can pan from an entire year down to a single day with your hands, then open a favorite memory in 3D.

An arcade wherever you are

Whether it's getting through a few levels at the airport gate or a long session on the couch, AURA gives your games a bigger screen. Since it's Android, you can play thousands of mobile and tablet games from Google Play or bring in games from your handheld or PC with Wired Mirroring. You can also keep other apps open beside the game, like a YouTube walkthrough or a chat with friends. And if you get stuck while playing an Android title or streaming from your PC or console, just ask Gemini to talk you through your next move, so you don't have to put down your controller.

Play your favorites on a bigger screen, or try new games made for XR.

Games made for XR, from studios like Owlchemy Labs, and Resolution Games, also appear right in your space, and you can play them naturally with your hands. New ones are coming with AURA, too, including Fallout Factions and Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars.

Available to order today

XREAL AURA is available for users 18+ to order today in the U.S., Canada, and Korea, and starting November 2 in Japan, with launch pricing starting at USD 1,099 through the end of the year. You can order at xreal.com/aura, or in the U.S. at BestBuy.com with shipments beginning in mid-November. And if you’re looking to bring AURA to your business, check out the Android Enterprise Blog to learn more about scaled deployment options.

entries.title: Build and manage Connected Apps in one place
entries.summary: A split-screen graphic showing a Google search interface connecting to Gemini to confirm a dinner reservation.
entries.content:
From ordering groceries to making playlists, Connected Apps in Search and the Gemini app have made everyday tasks faster and easier.

To help users get more done, today we’re launching the preview of our Connected Apps Platform, a unified way for more app developers to bring their capabilities directly into Gemini and Search. We’re also rolling out a new set of Connected Apps partners to give people even more ways to streamline their day.

Manage Connected Apps with ease

The Connected Apps Platform gives developers the opportunity to build once and reach high-intent users across both Search and the Gemini app. Developers integrate with a cloud-hosted MCP server or Android MCP using the AppFunctions APIs, then use the Google Connected Console to register, test, and submit their app. Before review, developers choose whether it will go live in Search, the Gemini app, or both. Once live, you can track traffic, latency, and error rates, and keep control of your brand identity, including verified logos and authenticated accounts.

We're opening access in phases, and will add more developers, markets, and Google products over the coming months. Sign up for the preview and explore the documentation at developers.google.com/connected-apps.

Connect to your favorite tools

We’ve launched more than 50 Connected Apps between Search and Gemini in areas ranging from productivity and event ticketing to health and fitness. Integrations with partners like Adobe, Experian, Localiza, and Peloton are live for users in Gemini, and in the coming weeks, we’ll be bringing these Connected Apps to Search as well. Among other apps, we'll also be launching a new integration with Calm across both Search and Gemini.

To see all the Connected Apps you can access, visit our help center pages for Search and Gemini.

entries.title: Chrome’s enhanced autofill helps you fill out forms with suggestions pulled from Gmail.
entries.content:
Filling out online forms can be tedious, especially when you have to switch between tabs or search through your inbox to track down information. While autofill has always handled the basics — like your name, address, and credit card number — now it’s handling even more.

Starting today, Chrome’s enhanced autofill feature can automatically suggest information pulled directly from Gmail as you fill out online forms. Using Gemini with Personal Intelligence, it can surface details like order numbers, tracking information, and flight bookings, right when you need them.

As always, sensitive data is encrypted and you remain in control. You can manage whether enhanced autofill is enabled and what it can access via your Chrome settings.

These capabilities are beginning to roll out in the U.S. on desktop, Android and iOS for Gemini in Chrome users with Personal Intelligence enabled.

entries.title: Indie Games Fund in Africa: Meet the selected studios
entries.summary: Header graphic for Indie Games Fund Africa featuring a blue cartoon character celebrating next to a large yellow ring and two sparkling stars against a teal background, with the Google Play logo in the bottom right corner.
entries.content:
Indie Games Fund Africa: Meet the selected studios

Sub-Saharan Africa is home to some of the world's most vibrant storytelling, cultural richness, and creative ingenuity, powering one of the fastest-growing game development ecosystems on the planet.

Earlier this year, we opened applications for the first-ever Google Play Indie Games Fund in Africa, committing $1 million to help bridge the funding gap, overcome international distribution barriers, and support talented indie developers across the continent.

Today, we are thrilled to announce the 10 independent game studios selected for the 2026 cohort.

Each of these studios will receive a share of non-dilutive funding, alongside direct access to commercial and growth resources, hands-on 1:1 mentorship from Google Play specialists, and tailored technical support from Unity. This support is designed to help them optimize their titles, scale sustainably, and bring authentic African stories and gameplay mechanics to a worldwide audience.

Meet the 10 selected studios

From action platformers, cozy puzzles, and rhythm games to immersive simulations, meet the studios shaping the future of African gaming:

  • Clockwork Acorn (South Africa): A South African indie game studio founded in 2014 by industry veterans dedicated to making timeless games, supporting local talent, and creating a positive impact through their work. Jetstream is an elegant puzzle game featuring over 100 hand-crafted levels, a calming minimalist art style, and unique mechanics that challenge players to guide a plane through the clouds.
  • Deluxe Entertainment Studios (Nigeria): An independent studio creating distinct games featuring striking visuals, bold ideas, and unique stories rooted in African imagination for global audiences. Their title Rasta Santa is an action-packed 2D platformer set in Lagos, where you play as an undercover cop disguised as Santa, waging war on traffickers to rescue children and defend an orphanage.
  • Disputed People (South Africa): A South African studio founded in 2023 that is dedicated to crafting rich, character-driven video games filled with creativity, quality, and wonder-filled experiences. Their title Mitts and the Divine Recipes is a 3D retro-inspired adventure game where players explore the cozy world of Epicuria, gathering divine ingredients, cooking meals to gain special abilities, and solving puzzles to advance.
  • Fer Factor (Nigeria): An independent game development studio based in Lagos, Nigeria, dedicated to crafting fun, innovative, and memorable gaming experiences for players worldwide. Their title Chore Master is a cozy and satisfying game where players use intuitive controls to clean spaces, scrub stains, and transform chaotic rooms into spotless, picture-perfect environments.
  • Gazuntype Entertainment (Nigeria): The independent game development alias of Tade Ajiboye, an innovative builder with over a decade of experience crafting immersive video games and VR experiences in Nigeria. Their title Go North is a cozy, story-driven exploration adventure where players guide Dara through beautifully unique mazes, discover magical items, and uncover a sinister mystery.
  • Leti Games Limited (Ghana): A pioneering African creative technology studio based in Ghana, dedicated to bringing authentic African stories and innovations to global audiences through games and interactive experiences. Their title Sweave is a rhythm-based, hyper-casual mobile game inspired by traditional African weaving techniques, where players navigate a dynamic weaving ball across a digital loom while dodging cultural obstacles and battling bosses.
  • Maliyo Games (Nigeria): A Lagos-based studio founded in 2012 that creates engaging, African-inspired gaming experiences celebrating local culture for a global audience. Their title Safari City is a vibrant mobile puzzle and renovation game where players solve match-3 puzzles and restore a rundown town into a beautiful, thriving community.
  • Studio Bo (South Africa): An animation and games company based in Cape Town, South Africa, known for bringing a playful visual style and quirky humor to interactive experiences, animations, and upcoming mobile titles. Their title Idle Sands is a cozy 2D idle-clicker where players manage a fleet of robots to clean up a beach, uncover treasures, and automate their operations with relaxing music and charming artwork.
  • Vetkoek Studios (South Africa): A youth-owned South African game development studio dedicated to creating high-quality, accessible mobile games with authentic African themes while empowering the next generation of local creators. Their title Taxi Ranked is a casual, retro-style driving game capturing the chaos and humor of South African minibus taxis through vibrant comic-book graphics, multiple game modes, and deep vehicle customization.
  • Weza Interactive (Kenya): A Kenyan game studio founded by twin brothers Odongo George Ahere and James Ahere to build original, culturally rich worlds that educate, empower, and entertain global audiences. Their title Riziki is a free-to-play mobile rhythm adventure where players guide twins Nabo and Moja across Africa, tapping and swiping to Afrobeats, Amapiano, and Rhumba to restore harmony and bring vibrant environments to life.

Congratulations to all 10 studios. We're excited to champion your vision as you continue crafting unforgettable experiences for players around the world.
